qa: Yes, it can. A "switch the target of attack" effect such as affects the attacking Digimon itself, therefore the target of attack can be switched to a Digimon that isn't affected by effects.

text_sections.label: Effect
text_sections.text: ＜Blocker＞＜Armor Purge＞ [When Digivolving] If [Magnamon (X Antibody)] or an [Armor Form] trait card is in this Digimon's digivolution cards, until your opponent's turn ends, this Digimon gets +3000 DP and isn't affected by your opponent's effects. Then, it unsuspends. [All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When security stacks are removed from, you may activate 1 of this Digimon's [When Digivolving] effects. (Rule) Trait: Has [Free] Attribute.
